dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle area.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate grey/blue-grey across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density distribution of small, dark-pixel clusters (speckling) visible primarily across the mid-dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between slightly darker mid-line regions and lighter lateral margins.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, scattered dark spots are visible across the dorsal plane, consistent with textural mottling rather than distinct lesions.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent circular blowhole aperture and a clearly defined longitudinal dorsal ridge.
